reply_text:
I have to wait. The check needs each row's trace output, and a row only produces that when its probe finishes.

I just checked: both lanes are still on their first row (PersistentHashMap.foldl and PersistentHashMap.mkCollisionNode, started 14:40), and none of the 18 has produced output yet. The rows run one after another in two lanes at about 4–8 minutes each, so all 18 should be done in roughly an hour.

I'm parked on that. When the last row finishes, a watcher wakes me. I'll then compare every row's expression and stack fingerprints against the six I already have (741a93c4 / 365b1b90), list any row that differs as a second mechanism, and bell claude-4. If you'd rather have partial results sooner, I can check in periodically and report rows as they land.
